# RKN (Ravi Kumar Nagda)

RKN (Ravi Kumar Nagda) is a developer and student at SRM. His portfolio is https://beingrkn.com/.

RKN (Ravi Kumar Nagda) builds games, tools, Discord systems, Minecraft server infrastructure, online communities, web projects, tutorials, articles, reels, and live streams. His work spans indie game development, Discord bots, Minecraft plugins, creator/community operations, automation systems, and creator content.

## Main Portfolio Summary

RKN (Ravi Kumar Nagda), mostly known online by the social username beingrkn, is a developer creating Discord tools, Minecraft servers, indie games, community systems, and internet products. His portfolio highlights work managing Discord communities at scale, building games, creating Minecraft and Discord systems, writing articles, making tutorials, posting reels, and streaming game development.

RKN (Ravi Kumar Nagda) has worked with creator communities and online communities, including Minecraft events and gaming server infrastructure. He has built systems that serve large Discord and Minecraft communities and has experience with Python, Java, Discord.py, Spigot API, MongoDB, Unity, C#, Godot, GDScript, TypeScript, React, Flask, Supabase, and automation workflows.

## Journey / Career Path

### Head of Operations at R.O.T.I.

RKN (Ravi Kumar Nagda) is Head of Operations at R.O.T.I. from May 2025 to present. He oversees strategy and scaling for a top-tier multipurpose Discord bot, coordinates development and community teams, and manages operations for 76.8k+ communities, 17.3M+ members, and a 4.98/5 rating.

R.O.T.I. website: https://letsroti.com/

### Technical Lead at Overlab.in

RKN (Ravi Kumar Nagda) is Technical Lead at Overlab.in from November 2025 to present. He oversees technical operations and platform growth, manages and coordinates a team of developers, and built and currently manages Overlab's website.

Overlab website: https://www.overlab.in/

### Community Manager and Lead Developer for Mr. Random

RKN (Ravi Kumar Nagda) has been Community Manager and Lead Developer for Mr. Random from February 2021 to present. He led India's largest 20-day Minecraft event, built for a #1 ranked Indian and world #8 most-voted Minecraft server, developed 10+ custom plugins, and coordinated moderators, creators, and community teams.

Mr. Random YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@MrRandomUniverse

### Lead Python Developer for Orator

RKN (Ravi Kumar Nagda) was Lead Python Developer for Orator from May 2022 to May 2023. He built a high-concurrency text-to-speech Discord bot with 50+ AI voices and scaled it to 34k+ servers and 3.4M members.

Orator Discord application: https://discord.com/discovery/applications/948637316145102868

### Founder and Lead Developer of Harmonium Craft

RKN (Ravi Kumar Nagda) was Founder and Lead Developer of Harmonium Craft from July 2021 to March 2022. Harmonium Craft was India's most-voted modded survival Minecraft server and handled 6k unique monthly players.

### Additional Creator and Community Work

RKN (Ravi Kumar Nagda) also worked with creators Mythpat and Andreobee on gaming community events and served as a community moderator at WEX Mobile.

## Games

### Chick Chick Go

Chick Chick Go is an indie arcade survival game by RKN (Ravi Kumar Nagda). It is a fast, cheerful survival game where the player dodges foxes, chains corn pickups, and grabs upgrades while the chaos escalates. The game focuses on bright visuals, simple goals, quick movement, escalating pressure, and short survival loops that are easy to jump into while leaving room for mastery.

- Website: https://beingrkn.com/chickchickgo/
- Alternative page: https://beingrkn.com/games/chickchickgo/
- Play on itch.io: https://beingrkn.itch.io/chick-chick-go
- Watch gameplay: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=14FZys3CwiQ

### Temp Tension

Temp Tension is an indie survival game by RKN (Ravi Kumar Nagda), made for the BYOG 2026 game jam in under 72 hours. The player's life is time: if lifetime reaches zero, the run ends. Resources such as wood and stone decay in the world, inventory resources can disappear over time, and pickups must be brought inside the red range circle, selected with the arrow keys, and claimed with Space before they vanish. Players can craft tools like the axe and pickaxe to automatically pick up nearby resources while surviving red, green, and purple enemies that reduce or steal lifetime.

- Website: https://beingrkn.com/temptension/
- Alternative page: https://beingrkn.com/games/temptension/
- Play on itch.io: https://beingrkn.itch.io/temp-tension

## Featured Projects

### Temp Tension

Category: Game Dev
Tech and skills: Godot, GDScript, survival loop design, game jam scope
Description: A 72-hour BYOG 2026 survival game where life is time, resources decay, and the player must claim pickups, craft tools, and survive three enemy behaviors.

### Chick Chick Go

Category: Game Dev
Tech and skills: arcade gameplay design, survival loop design, UI polish
Description: A cheerful arcade survival game where players dodge foxes, chain corn pickups, and grab upgrades as runs become more chaotic.

### RandomGPT Discord Assistant

Category: Discord Bots
Tech: Python, Pillow
Description: An advanced custom Discord bot with AI conversations, logo generation, and live IPL scoreboard integration. It includes image manipulation, a Mrify logo command, generative AI chat, live IPL scoreboard, MongoDB-backed credits, and a smart voice channel join system.

Key features:
- Mrify Command: Generates personalized Mr. Random-themed logos in custom colors, detects gender from Discord roles, and uses a MongoDB credit system.
- Generative AI Chatbot: Real-time AI-powered conversational assistant for Discord communities.
- Live IPL Scoreboard: Discord.py and MongoDB command for live cricket match data.
- Smart Voice Channel Join System: Lets users request entry into full voice channels through interactive approve/deny buttons.

Impact: Enhanced community interaction and progression through gamified credit systems and real-time utility features.

### Portfolio Web: Mehul Sen

Category: Web
Tech: Python Flask, Supabase, GSAP, Cashfree API, HTML5/CSS3
Description: A high-performance premium portfolio for leading Indian video editor Mehul Sen. The platform includes a custom Flask-based digital assets store with account creation, secure Cashfree payments, payment verification, and protected downloads.

Website: https://www.mehulsen.in/

### Multiple Minecraft Events for Mr. Random

Category: Minecraft
Tech: Java, Spigot API
Description: RKN (Ravi Kumar Nagda) organized and built systems for large Minecraft events for Mr. Random, including India's largest 20-day Minecraft event and the first-ever Minecraft civilization event for Mr. Random. More than 1000 people applied; 60 were selected and distributed into Desert, Snow, and Forest teams. The event included custom mechanics, team advantages and disadvantages, anti-cheat infrastructure, and event systems.

Impact: Managed and built custom infrastructure for India's largest 20-day Minecraft event with 60 active players.

### Minecraft-Discord Voice Verification

Category: Automation
Tech: Java, Python, MongoDB
Description: A real-time cross-platform sync system connecting Minecraft servers with Discord voice channels. RKN (Ravi Kumar Nagda) built a Discord bot in Python that updated MongoDB voice state records and a Minecraft Java plugin that checked the database before allowing players to join. If a player left Discord voice chat while in-game, the plugin could detect the change and remove them from the server.

Impact: Increased Discord server activity by requiring voice channel participation during active Minecraft sessions.

### IPL XP Betting System

Category: Discord Bots
Tech: Python, Discord.py
Description: An XP-based match prediction and betting system for the 2025 IPL event in Mr. Random's community. It allowed users to place XP-based bets on IPL matches inside Discord, with XP deduction, match locking, result processing, and leaderboard updates. The system later migrated to Skybot while retaining core components and logic originally written by RKN (Ravi Kumar Nagda).

Read more: https://github.com/MrRandomUniverse/IPL-Event-2025/blob/main/README.md

### Team Chat Plugin

Category: Minecraft
Tech: Java, Spigot API
Description: A custom Minecraft Java plugin for a Mr. Random special event with Desert, Snow, and Forest teams. It added a toggleable team-only chat system so players could switch between team communication and global chat during gameplay.

Impact: Improved coordination and team organization for faction-based Minecraft events.

### Overlab.in

Category: Web
Tech: TypeScript, React
Description: RKN (Ravi Kumar Nagda) designed, developed, and manages the Overlab website, helping the agency build a strong and scalable digital presence.

Website: https://www.overlab.in/

### Holix

Category: Web / Interactive / Game Dev
Tech: Godot, GDScript
Description: Holix is a playful Holi website where users can throw colored water balloons at any X profile picture inside a 3D scene. Users can load a custom X profile image and interact with it in-game.

Links:
